verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a consumer authenticator app, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking controls. Nearby features such as encrypted backups, disabling multi-device, and blocking new installations are security controls, not telemetry opt-outs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
